ara (DevEx): quick report: sampleapp rerank failed in local smoke: embeddings batch returned mixed dims after an auth refresh retry -> rerank rejects with "inconsistent vector dimensions".

tom (SDK Eng): hm. do you have a minimal trace?

ara (DevEx): shapes printed: [512,512,768,512]. Also saw one item serialized as {vector:[...]} while others were raw arrays. Happens only when creds refresh mid-batch.

mira (Backend): likely cause: retried item routed to a different model_variant during re-dispatch. server logs show two model_ids for same request_id.

tom (SDK Eng): parity gap: node/py handle envelopes slightly differently and retry-merge path in both SDKs assumes arrays. I'll add a short-term client-side normalize: detect max dim and pad zeros, plus warn.

janet (PM): any customer impact?

ara (DevEx): one staging run failed; no production reports yet but high risk.

ci-bot: Created PR #2310: sdk/normalize-embed-on-retry (tom)

mira (Backend): filing BE-1290 to pin model_variant across retries and centralize postproc at merge time.

tom (SDK Eng): plan: push client fix + unit tests in next few hours, add CI check in sampleapp to catch mixed dims, update README and SDK changelog.

ara (DevEx): add a tiny troubleshooting snippet for onboarding docs to show how to reproduce locally.

janet (PM): thanks, please ping when PRs merge so support can be notified.
